name: SNOLAB — Vale Creighton Mine, Sudbury, Ontario

summary.plain: SNOLAB, two kilometres underground in Vale's Creighton nickel mine near Sudbury, Ontario: the surface site at 9 Shaft and the original SNO cavity that anchors the underground laboratory.
summary.technical: Local map for facility:snolab. Surface geometry from OpenStreetMap (the SNOLAB office node and the Creighton Mine industrial landuse polygon). The underground cavity is a derived 22 m circle centred on the SNO NIM detector paper's own published coordinate, cross-checked against the same paper's stated diameter. SNOLAB's other experiment halls (SNO+, DEAP-3600, DAMIC, SuperCDMS SNOLAB, nEXO, NEWS-G) share this one sourced site coordinate and have no distinct footprint located.
